items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Buddy played a nice relaxed tone

ctx.x: Played nice This is real too, Albert Artigue, December the 15th, 1961 Okay, you were saying Sam Morgan and Buddy Petit played nice
Yeah, well I like Sam's style and I like Buddy's style Buddy played a nice relaxed tone
Was Sam loud or soft or like that? No, he had a nice tone
